title: Register position constraints
statement: Let a call specification list register indices, let $c_0$ assign an integer position to every register, and let $W$ assign a finite Boolean word to every register. A position assignment $p$ satisfies the register box if, for every register $r$, it equals $c_0(r)$ when $r$ is absent from the call's list; when $r$ occurs in the list, it lies between $-1$ and the length of $W(r)$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: Call specification with an ordered list of register indices
Initial integer position for every register
Finite Boolean word for every register
Integer position assignment for every register
